body.en: Haru Anchor Shot, Pointer Move, and Cost Reduction

Anchor Shot is Haru's Main Damage Source
2 Cost Scaling Attack at base, but it's best Version is Combo Anchor Shot
This Combo is Active as long as you use any Justice/Blue card before using it
Anchor Pointer has "Move"
"Move" transfers the Card directly from zones into Hand
"Move" can transfer from "Deck" "Discard and "Used" Pile
"Move" counts as Draw, Only if Moving the card from Deck, not Discard/Used
Anchor Shot is the reason that Haru uses Justice Memory Set
BUT If you start to Reduce it's Cost from Divines/Gesture of Freedom
Justice Set Effect will BREAK since Anchor Shot won't be 2+ Cost
You can then use:
Conqueror 1 Cost Anchor Shot
2/2/2 0 Cost Anchor Shot/Ecstasy Span

body.en: Charge Energy and Lift Anchor, Anchor Shot Scaling

Charge Energy 3 is BROKEN, 70% per Haru card in hand is Insane
40% The highest Multiplier from Charge Energy is only 144% on Anchor Shot
That means Charge 3 only requires 2 Cards 140%, to Break even
Anything after that is just straight up better
It's cap is 630% FOR THE WHOLE TURN, Insane if you can set it up
You do need to be able to discard and redraw non Haru cards for this usually
Nia is very good at this, Cassius less so
Lift Anchor is REALLY BAD, It'sDamage, but also ALOT of AP increased
The Scaling from Anchor Shot is "Generic Additive"
Generic Additive is used in the formula after "Generic Multiplicatives"
Like Charge Energy or Lift Anchor

E2 Allows Anchor Shot to be played for Left over AP with Damage Reduced
E2 is 40% FINAL DAMAGE REDUCTION PER MISSING AP
E6 is 20% FINAL DAMAGE REDUCTION PER MISSING AP
E2 Examples:
2 Cost Anchor Shot, Used at 1 AP -40% = 60% Final Damage
2 Cost Anchor Shot, Used at 0 AP -80% = 20% Final Damage
3 Cost Anchor Shot, Used at 0 AP -120% = 0% Final Damage
Funny enough when it comes to Tenacity Dealt, it's based on the Initial Cost
Forbidden Gesture of Freedom/Narja making Anchors 0 cost perma are great
Since you don't actually lose damage
